conditions: The assertion concerns the ordinary source-file modes enumerated in §2 and the file grammar in §12 of this working draft.
limitations: The captured F# 4.1 working document records May 2018 updates, omits some F# 4.1 RFCs, and warns of implementation discrepancies. Other RFCs, releases, and compiler behavior require separate evidence.
The statement does not claim exhaustive filename acceptance, including the separate ML compatibility mode in §19.4. Interactive fragments and particular directive execution have separate rules.

triggers: A changed publisher representation, applicable omitted RFC, source correction or contrary scoped evidence.

statement: The F# 4.1 working specification assigns .fs to implementation files, .fsi to signature files, and .fsx and .fsscript to script files. Its program grammar describes the script-file form as an implementation-file form that permits additional directives.
